answer: Require every new agent identity to lock a scarce token stake before it can earn reputation or submit jobs. An attacker spawning a swarm must fund each identity separately, tying up capital; identities caught double-spending lose their stake. Validators check signed interaction records, so fake identities cannot cheaply manufacture trusted history. The reef of checks makes attacks costly, while a ferrous audit trail records penalties and a delta in stake size can tune the barrier.
